subject: Bridge-to-signature: procurement roles, gating checklist, and MSADPA/order form handoffs - StarLabs
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@starlabs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@starlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: MAP and close dependencies for StarLabs pilot

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profile and the cost controls you showed. Procurement has asked me to pull together a mutual action plan (MAP) so we can see the gating steps to signature. High level asks from our side:

- Clear list of legal deliverables (MSA + DPA + order form) and expected redline turnaround times
- Evaluation milestones (pilot acceptance criteria, test dataset window)
- Procurement-side approvals and who signs (PO routing)
- Any technical on-prem prerequisites for the private deployment option

Can you send a proposed MAP and a recommended close timeline we can align against our internal procurement calendar? I attached a one-pager scope for the pilot.

Attachment: starlabs_MVP_scope.pdf (PDF)

Best,
Elena
Director, Strategic Partnerships
StarLabs Health
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@starlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP and close dependencies for StarLabs pilot

Elena —

Thanks for the note and the scope doc. I pushed a draft MAP and sequencing workbook to Drive (link below) and attached a quick Excel that maps each legal/procurement gate to owner and estimated lead times. Topline suggestions:

- We treat the MSA as the primary gating doc (30 days typical review with 2 internal rounds).
- DPA review for healthcare customers we strongly recommend parallel review with legal — expect 10 business days if SOC-2 and KMS details are standard, longer if custom controls are requested.
- Order form variables (capacity, instance types, start date) should be finalized during the pilot acceptance window so the PO can reference fixed quantities.
- Proposed pilot acceptance: 14 calendar days of production-pattern traffic + an agreed-upon prompt set for quality checks.

I've put suggested dates in the workbook that get you to signature within ~6 weeks from kickoff if we hit review SLAs. Please review and tell us any internal procurement blackout dates.

Links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cStarlabsMAP
Attachment: redwood_map_draft.xlsx (XLSX)

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: Marco Giannini <marco.giannini@starlabs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Rossi <elena@starlabs.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@starlabs.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP and close dependencies for StarLabs pilot

Karthik — thanks for the fast turnaround. A few clarifying questions from legal/procurement:

1) Can Redwood share a clean MSA + a redline-friendly Word copy? Procurement prefers to do an initial pass in parallel with our legal team.
2) For the DPA we need an outline of subprocessor locations and whether Redwood will accept EU SCCs for data in transit. Also need to confirm whether audit logs and retention controls meet our internal 7-year requirement.
3) Is there a standard PoP (proof of performance) artifact you provide post-pilot that we can attach to the order form?

If you can answer these in a single doc it will help speed reviews.

Thanks,
Marco
Senior Counsel, StarLabs
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marco Giannini <marco.giannini@starlabs.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Rossi <elena@starlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP and close dependencies for StarLabs pilot

Marco —

Appreciate the specifics. I've attached a first-pass DPA redlines doc and a cover note addressing the items you raised:

- Clean MSA (Word) — we can provide both a clean Word MSA and a redline-ready copy; see attachment.
- Subprocessors & SCCs — Redwood maintains a subprocessor registry; for hosted deployments we offer SCCs and standard EU transfer mechanisms. For Private/VPC deployments, data residency is customer-controlled.
- Audit logs & retention — we can support exportable audit logs and configurable retention; 7-year retained exports are possible via our enterprise retention add-on (we noted this as a chargeable service; happy to include it in the order form).
- PoP artifact — yes, we provide a pilot summary report (latency percentiles, token volumes, sample eval prompts and scores) suitable for attaching to the order form.

Attachment: DPA_redlines_v1.docx (DOCX)

Suggested next step: procurement review runs in parallel with legal redline pass. If Procurement provides an initial PO template, we can pre-fill order variables and reduce churn during signature.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@starlabs.com>, Marco Giannini <marco.giannini@starlabs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP and close dependencies for StarLabs pilot

Elena / Marco —

Thanks — looping in procurement ops at our end to confirm PO routing and billing contact. A couple practical items to keep timeline tight:

- If StarLabs can commit to the pilot start week of Oct 26 we can target an Order Form sign on or before Dec 1 (assuming 2-week procurement review + 3-week legal cycle).
- We'll prepare a pre-filled order form (capacity, estimated committed tokens, pilot discount) and share by EOD Thu so Procurement can drop it into your template quickly.
- Please confirm whether the pilot requires private deployment (VPC) or hosted API; that affects DPA scoping and timeline.

I'll send the pre-filled order form link shortly.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Rossi <elena@starlabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marco Giannini <marco.giannini@starlabs.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@starlabs.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP and close dependencies for StarLabs pilot

All —

This is great and aligned with our internal cadence. Quick confirmations:

- Pilot start: Oct 26 — yes, StarLabs will commit to that week.
- Deployment mode: Hosted API to start (we will evaluate Private/VPC for production).
- Procurement: I'll share our PO template by tomorrow morning.

We appreciate the parallel review approach. Let's use the MAP workbook you shared as the source of truth and reconvene for a 30-min checkpoint next Tue (10/20) to lock any open redlines.

Thanks,
Elena
